The code responsible for the update is shown i n Figure 3 .
JavaScript code responsible for Able Desktop updates The downloaded update installer is saved to %USERPROFILE %\Documents\Able\Able Desktop.exe .

Th is campaign shows a connection with the ShadowPad back do or, as we observed network infrastructure overlap s between the ShadowPad C&C network infrastructure and one of the Tmanger C&C address es .
